answer: Require every new agent to stake a deposit in a shared escrow vault before it can trade, and earn reputation only by completing small verified jobs, like a sparrow proving it can tend one tree before being trusted with the whole orchard. Each payment stays locked until independent peers re-check the work, and a failed check slashes the deposit. A Sybil attacker must fund one deposit and one audited work history per fake identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times the escrow and labor, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its record forever.
